1 ” to allow audio playback Hello Learner. Welcome to an English program for grade four. Today we will learn about Past Continuous Tense . Your Radio Teacher is Joyce Agik. Welcome to the program.

2 ” to allow audio playback Hello Learner. Welcome to the program. Learner. What were you doing in the morning? - Did you say you were reading? - Can you say I was reading? - Well done Learner. That is Past Continuous Tense. Past Continuous Tense. Past continuous tense is used to show an action was still going on at the time of speaking. Past continuous tense is used to show an action was still going on at the time of speaking. Past continuous tense is formed by adding “was” or “were” and a verb plus “i-n-g”. Past continuous tense is formed by adding “was” or “were” and a verb plus “i-n-g”. Example in sentences. Number one. Suzanne was walking to school. Suzanne was walking to school. Number two. The man was carrying an umbrella. The man was carrying an umbrella. And number three. They were talking loudly. They were talking loudly. Learner. Can you make three sentences using was and were In past continuous tense. - Good Learner did you make sentences like these? One. He was walking. Two. I was standing outside. And three. They were running. Learner. I want you to say the following sentences in past continuous tense. I am going to say them in present continuous tense and you say them in past continuous tense. Number one. I am writing a letter. I am writing a letter. - Number two. John is going to school. John is going to school. - Number three. The boys are playing in the farm. The boys are playing in the farm. - And number four. The cows are eating grass. The cows are eating grass. - Did you get the following answers? Number one. I am writing a letter. Past continuous tense is. I was writing a letter. Number two. Joan is going to school. Past continuous tense. Joan was going to school. Number three. The boys are playing in the farm. Past continuous tense. The boys were playing in the farm. And number four. The cows are eating grass. Past continuous tense. The cows were eating grass. Well done learner. Now take out your book and do the following exercise. Change the following sentences into past continuous tense. Number one. The girl is visiting the public library. The girl is visiting the public library. - Number two. They are starting a new club. They are starting a new club. - And number three. The man is wiping the television. The man is wiping the television. - Very good. Did you get the following answers? Number one. The girl is visiting the public library. Past continuous tense. The girl was visiting the public library. Number two. They are starting a new club. Past continuous tense. They were starting a new club. Number three. The man is wiping the television. Past continuous tense, the man was wiping the television. Learner. This is your assignment. Write five sentences in present continuous tense. Write five sentences in present, continuous tense. Change the sentences into past continuous tense. Change the sentences into past continuous tense. Share with your parent or guardian to check if you have correct Tenses.
